# Universal Animation Library Standard — Playthings External Motion Source

This directory carries the exact CC0 GLB source used by the Playthings motion-authority template factory during Carrier Major 003 experiments.

- Upstream: Quaternius Universal Animation Library (Standard)
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal; exact bundled license is `LICENSE.txt`.
- Carried source: `UAL1_Standard.glb`
- Purpose: deterministic humanoid motion-authority rendering only; this source is not Playthings character art and not a generative output.

The local factory is `tools/playthings/generative_visual/ual_motion_template_factory.py`.
Generated authority examples from the proven `Walk_Loop` live under `reference/playthings/production/carrier-003/ual-template-factory-v01/`.
